provenance.how: pty output log of pomade-runner run delta/delta-ask 20261125-024739-b776ca (80x24): bytes exactly as logged. The log records no timing: it is cut into one chunk per claude frame (each opens with ESC[?25l) at synthetic times 150 ms apart; the frame that draws the question form also carries the answer that followed it, so it is cut before the answer's working title: the form 5 ms after the idle title (5100), the answer 930 ms after the form — Runner typed /exit 605 ms after the form and Enter 300 ms later (its run history), and the Enter picked option 1. The log ends with a full redraw at another size (a terminal attached); it is cut before that redraw
provenance.scenario: claude works, sets its idle title, and draws its AskUserQuestion form ("☐ Permission", options 1–4 with descriptions, 5. Type something., 6. Chat about this, footer "Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel") with the idle title still up; the Enter after /exit picks option 1 "Yes, append (Recommended)"; claude goes on, runs the command and ends its turn at its empty prompt
